+"""Prepare a release: bump the package version and add the release header to the release notes."""
+
+import re
+import sys
+from datetime import date
+from pathlib import Path
+
+INIT_FILE = Path("fastapi/__init__.py")
+RELEASE_NOTES_FILE = Path("docs/en/docs/release-notes.md")
+VERSION_PATTERN = re.compile(r'^__version__ = "(\d+\.\d+\.\d+)"$', re.MULTILINE)
+VERSION_STR_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$")
+
+
+def get_current_version(init_file: Path = INIT_FILE) -> str:
+    match = VERSION_PATTERN.search(init_file.read_text())
+    if not match:
+        raise ValueError(f"Version not found in {init_file}")
+    return match.group(1)
+
+
+def set_version(version: str, init_file: Path = INIT_FILE) -> None:
+    if not VERSION_STR_PATTERN.match(version):
+        raise ValueError(f"Invalid version: {version}")
+    content = init_file.read_text()
+    new_content, count = VERSION_PATTERN.subn(f'__version__ = "{version}"', content)
+    if count != 1:
+        raise ValueError(f"Version not found in {init_file}")
+    init_file.write_text(new_content)
+
+
+def add_release_header(
+    version: str,
+    release_notes_file: Path = RELEASE_NOTES_FILE,
+    today: str | None = None,
+) -> None:
+    today = today or date.today().isoformat()
+    content = release_notes_file.read_text()
+    header = f"## {version} ({today})"
+    if re.search(rf"^## {re.escape(version)}\b", content, re.MULTILINE):
+        raise ValueError(f"Release {version} already exists in {release_notes_file}")
+    marker = "## Latest Changes"
+    if marker not in content:
+        raise ValueError(f"'{marker}' not found in {release_notes_file}")
+    new_content = content.replace(f"{marker}\n", f"{marker}\n\n{header}\n", 1)
+    release_notes_file.write_text(new_content)
+
+
+def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> None:
+    args = sys.argv[1:] if argv is None else argv
+    if len(args) != 1:
+        print("Usage: python scripts/release.py <version>")
+        sys.exit(1)
+    version = args[0]
+    set_version(version)
+    add_release_header(version)
+    print(f"Prepared release {version}")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
